title: Terms Governing the Rate Carried by On-Site Controls Hours Where the Building Also Holds Maintenance Cover
content:
# Terms Governing the Rate Carried by On-Site Controls Hours Where the Building Also Holds Maintenance Cover

**Term 1.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier carries a repair labor discount of ten per cent or more, the on-site hours of a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans carry that maintenance agreement's own regular-hours labor rate.

**Term 2.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier carries a repair labor discount below ten per cent, the on-site hours carry the tier's on-site controls technician rate less eight per cent, taken to two decimal places.

**Term 3.** In every other case the on-site hours carry the tier's on-site controls technician rate.

The agreement, its standing and its tier's repair labor discount and regular-hours labor rate are read from the office's records of Preventive Maintenance Agreements written against that building.

| Maintenance agreement at the building standing active | Repair labor discount of that agreement's tier | Rate the on-site hours carry |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 10 per cent or more | that maintenance agreement's own regular-hours labor rate |
| yes | below 10 per cent | the tier's on-site controls technician rate less 8 per cent |
| no | not read | the tier's on-site controls technician rate |

## Boundary and worked figures (hypothetical)

- A repair labor discount of exactly 10 per cent falls under Term 1, the boundary being ten per cent or more; a discount of 9 per cent falls under Term 2.
- Under Term 2, with an on-site controls technician rate of 150 USD an hour, the on-site hours carry 150 USD less 8 per cent, that is 138.00 USD an hour.
- Under Term 1, with a maintenance agreement whose regular-hours labor rate is 132 USD an hour, the on-site hours carry 132 USD an hour, whatever the plan tier's own on-site controls technician rate may be.
